name: book_appointment
description: Patient wants to book a doctor appointment
context_question: I'm here to help. Could you briefly tell me what you're experiencing so I can suggest the right type of doctor and priority level?

name: cancel_appointment
description: Patient wants to cancel an existing appointment
context_question: I can help with that. Are you looking to cancel entirely, or would you prefer to reschedule to a different date?

name: prescription_refill
description: Patient wants to refill a prescription
context_question: Understood. Could you tell me which medication you need refilled and how urgently you need it?

name: lab_report_query
description: Patient asking about lab test results
context_question: I can look into that. Do you know which test results you're waiting for, and has your doctor already reviewed them with you?
